ecstatic: "YES! YES! THAT'S WHAT I'M TALKING ABOUT!"
"I'm going to frame this game and hang it in the downstairs loo!"
"Somebody get me a chair, I've gone all wobbly!"
"Best thing I've seen since my wedding day. Don't tell the wife."
"Ring my mum! Tell her I'm a genius!"
"I've split my trousers celebrating and I don't even care!"
"That's TEXTBOOK! I should write a textbook!"
"I've lost my voice and I don't want it back!"
"Somebody pinch me! Not you, Dennis, you pinch too hard!"
"Champagne football! Well, sparkling wine. Still lovely!"
"I could kiss the lot of you! I won't. But I could!"
"I'm doing a lap of honour. Nobody stop me."
"Best afternoon of my life, and I once won a meat raffle!"
happy: "I'm almost smiling. Don't make me regret it."
"Keep it simple. Pass, move, don't fall over."
"That's what we practised on Tuesday! Somebody was listening!"
"Good shape. Good effort. Good grief, we might win this."
"Calm and composed. Like a Sunday afternoon at the garden centre."
"That's it, keep the ball. Make them chase."
"Lovely. I might even let you have a biscuit at full-time."
neutral: "It's a bit of a chess match, this. Nobody's taken a pawn yet."
"Stay in shape. Wait for the moment."
"Somebody do something interesting, I'm losing the will."
"It's tight. Keep it tight. Tight's good."
"Not bad, not great. Like a lukewarm cup of tea."
"Keep the ball. Don't do anything daft."
"We're fine. We're fine. Are we fine? We're fine."
worried: "What are we doing? Seriously, what are we doing?"
"We're making this very hard for ourselves."
"I've got a bad feeling about this."
"This is not the plan. Where's the plan? Who's got the plan?"
"My blood pressure can't take much more of this."
"Tighten up at the back! Tighter than that!"
"I've seen better defending at an under-nines tournament."
"Can someone please just kick it out?"
"Not like this, lads. Not like this."
"We look like strangers who've met at a bus stop."
"Somebody grab this game by the scruff of the neck!"
"Keep it together. I'm barely keeping it together."
furious: "My nan could've done better, and she's had both hips done!"
"Are you lot even trying? Be honest."
"I'm having a word at half-time. Several words. Loud ones."
"That's the worst thing I've ever seen, and I've seen my brother-in-law dance!"
"Get your heads out of the clouds!"
"Nobody's getting a day off this week. NOBODY."
"I'll be fining someone for that. I don't know who yet."
"Have you ever met a football before?!"
"I've thrown my coat on the floor and it's my good coat!"
"You're playing like a bunch of wardrobes!"
"Somebody hold me back. Actually, don't. Let me at them."
"Double training. Triple training. Training on Christmas Day!"
"That was a disgrace, and I'm including the kit in that."

halfTimeTalk.winning: Half-time team talk: "Good half. Nobody gets complacent, and nobody touches the custard creams until we've won."
halfTimeTalk.drawing: Half-time team talk: "It's there for us, lads. Be braver on the ball and stop passing it to them."
halfTimeTalk.losing: Half-time team talk: "Right. Cups down. That wasn't good enough and you all know it. Go out there and fix it."

great: "Outstanding. I'd give you a pay rise if it was my money."
"That's the best I've seen from you. Don't let it go to your head. Bit late for that, I suspect."
"Magnificent. I've told the kit man to wash your shirt separately."
"Play like that every week and I'll name my next dog after you."
"That's a performance they'll be talking about in the pub for years."
"World class. Well, our-division class. Which is better than nothing."
good: "You did your job. That's all I ask. Well, I ask for more, but that'll do."
"Good lad. I've got no complaints, which is rare."
"Tidy performance. Your mum will be pleased."
"That's the kind of game that keeps you in the team."
ok: "Bit quiet. Bit average. Bit like a Tuesday."
"Fine. Just fine. I need more than fine."
"You were there. I'll give you that."
"Some good bits, some not so good bits. Mostly middle bits."
"Not your best, not your worst. Somewhere in the beige."
"Room for improvement. Quite a big room."
"You did alright. Alright's not going to win us the league."
poor: "I've had more threat from a pedalo."
"Were you actually playing? I genuinely couldn't tell."
"About as much use as a chocolate teapot."
"Dreadful. Go home and have a long think."
"My nan's cardigan put in more of a shift."
"I want to forget that performance. Help me forget it."
"If that's your best, we're in trouble."
"You looked like you'd never seen a football before."
"I've seen better first touches on a bouncy castle."
